# T-2: Add draft steps

<!-- Auto-generated by `sdd-forge spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Add draft question triage/repair and draft coverage triage/repair leaves to the flow definition, next-action prompts, and registry routing.

## Acceptance Criteria
- New leaves appear after each draft review stage and before the next draft consumer.
- The new leaf ids are draft-questions-triage, draft-questions-repair, draft-coverage-triage, and draft-coverage-repair.
- next-action resolves instructions for each new leaf.
- Registry hooks advance draft review, triage, and repair leaves according to PASS/ADVISORY/FAIL routing.
- Active-flow migration marks inserted leaves done when the following consumer step is already in_progress or done and pending otherwise.

## Implementation Notes
Keep step ids internal and stable. Ensure active-flow migration inserts missing leaves without resetting completed unrelated steps.

## Test Strategy
Flow-state tests assert inserted steps, next action order, and post-hook status changes.
